title: Sustainable magnesium doped nanofibrillated cellulose/bentonite composite for enhanced phosphate removal: process optimization and mechanistic insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4602-4617
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08609D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Archana Pandey, Ajay S. Kalamdhad, Yogesh Chandra Sharma
A high-capacity magnesium-doped NFC/BN composite was developed for enhanced phosphate removal. The adsorbent showed fast kinetics, strong selectivity, reusability, and enabled nutrient recovery with soil water retention benefits.
